defects.witness: bun -e 'const m = await import("./starter/access-control.ts"); const first = m.parsePasscodeSessionCookie("upub_session=tok123"); const later = m.parsePasscodeSessionCookie("theme=dark; upub_session=tok123"); if (first !== "tok123" || later !== null) { console.error("expected first-position hit + later-position miss, got", {first, later}); process.exit(1); } console.log("reproduced: session cookie is only found when it is the FIRST pair — any preceding cookie makes it invisible");'
